name: Option Date Or Period 1 Choice
definition: Provides the exercise date or notice period for a call/put option.

EarliestExerciseDate.name: Earliest Exercise Date
EarliestExerciseDate.definition: First date on which the call option or the put option can be exercised.

NoticePeriod.name: Notice Period
NoticePeriod.definition: Number of calendar days that the holder of the instrument/issuer of the instrument will give to the issuer/holder of the instrument before exercising the put/call option.
